$ref.title: URI Reference
$ref.description: A reference to a statically identified schema.  This keyword must be set to an absolute URI or a relative reference as defined by [RFC 3986](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc3986), where its fragment (if any) can consist of a JSON Pointer as defined by [RFC 6901](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6901).

omitWhenMerged.title: Omit when merged
omitWhenMerged.description: Whether the field must be discarded during merging.

deprecated.title: Deprecated
deprecated.description: Information about the deprecation of this field.

deprecatedVersion.title: Deprecated version
deprecatedVersion.description: The OCDS version in which this field was first deprecated.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the reason for this field's deprecation.

codelist.title: Codelist
codelist.description: The CSV file that defines the codes in the codelist that this field refers to.

openCodelist.title: Open codelist
openCodelist.description: Whether the codelist that this field refers to is an open codelist.

wholeListMerge.title: Whole list merge
wholeListMerge.description: Whether the field's value must be treated as a literal when merging.
